name: OECD GlobalRecalls API
description: Publishes product recall nodes to the OECD GlobalRecalls portal via its import API, with search and delete.
project_description:
This module interfaces with the API of the OECD GlobalRecalls portal . This allows you to take nodes on your site containing product recall notices and publish them on the OECD GlobalRecalls portal. The configuration page allows you to enter your API key and configure mapping between the fields on your nodes and the fields on the OECD GlobalRecalls portal.

 Please note that this module has not been developed by the OECD and the OECD neither endorses nor requires its use, nor provides any warranty or indemnity for its use.
